mainInstruction: Open the panel you need with the buttons below.
settingsInstruction: Choose a setting to change. Values that need free text still use direct commands.
toolsInstruction: Choose skills, diagnostics, logs, backup, export, cleanup, or maintenance tools.
sandboxDescription: Choose the Codex CLI sandbox mode.
approvalDescription: Choose the Codex CLI approval policy.
streamDescription: Choose whether to use Codex SDK runStreamed.
gitDescription: Choose whether to skip the git repo check.
fastInstruction: Choose the fast service tier with the buttons.
pathsDirect: Direct input is required for /workdir <absolute-dir> or /adddir <absolute-dir>.
pathsButtons: Buttons only restore defaults or clear additional directories.
liveAgent: Shows only intermediate comments that Codex actually sends.
liveActivity: Shows command, file-change, and tool activity.
liveTurnCompleted: Wrapping up and preparing the final answer.
liveReasoning: Analyzing the request and planning the next step.
liveTodoRemaining: Planned the work order. Remaining steps: {remaining}
liveFileFailed: File change failed; checking it now.
liveToolFailed: Tool call failed; checking it now: {tool}
liveItemError: Checking an error signal from the task.
commandUsage: 📊 Show selected account usage and limits
pdfUploadedDetail: No Codex turn was started. Reply to this PDF or mention the uploaded PDF in your next request.
unsupportedDocument: Only image documents and PDF files are supported.
unsupportedMessage: Only text messages, image attachments, and PDF documents are supported.
telegramUnauthorizedUser: 🔒 This Telegram user is not allowed to use the bot. Ask the administrator to register your user ID.
telegramDisallowedChat: 🔒 The bot is not enabled in this chat. Please try again in an allowed chat.
telegramDisallowedThread: 🔒 The bot is not enabled in this topic. Please try again in an allowed topic.
usageRefreshConfirmBody: This runs a tiny Codex turn in a separate probe thread to fetch a fresh usage sample. It can consume a small amount of Codex quota.
usageRefreshRunningBody: Running a tiny probe turn in a separate thread...
contextCompactContinueTitle: Codex context is getting full; continuing in the same thread with auto compact enabled.
cleanupModeConfirmBody: The selected mode permanently deletes eligible items every day without another approval. Active-thread protection, quarantine age checks, pre-delete backups, and manifests remain enabled.
cleanupImportantHandoffWarning: Create handoff docs before quarantining important threads.
cleanupNoFilesUntilButton: No files move or delete until you press a button.
cleanupPlanNotFoundBody: It was already handled or expired.
cleanupProcessingBody: Button input received. The action button is temporarily disabled to prevent duplicate execution.
cleanupFinishReplace: This message will be replaced with the final result.
cleanupNoFilesMoved: No files were moved or deleted.
maintenanceIntro: Provides report-only, backup-first, archive-only actions following keep-codex-fast principles.
maintenanceScope: Checks and cleans worktree/log/config state separately from thread cleanup.
maintenanceReportDesc: No file moves, deletion, or DB changes
maintenanceBackupDesc: Create a Codex metadata backup only
maintenanceConfigDesc: Back up, then remove missing project blocks
maintenanceLogsDesc: Move oversized logs_2.sqlite files to archived_logs
maintenanceRepairDesc: Back up, then bound thread-list display metadata
maintenanceHandoffDesc: Create a repo-local document for the current thread
busyBackupDetail: This message will be replaced with the result when it finishes.
busyConfigDetail: Backs up first, then removes only missing project blocks.
busyWorktreesDetail: Moves them to archived_worktrees without deleting them.
busyLogsDetail: Moves logs_2.sqlite files above the threshold into archived_logs.
busyRepairDetail: Backs up first, then bounds only title/preview display metadata. Session transcripts stay intact.
busyHandoffDetail: Creates a handoff document for the Codex thread connected to this Telegram chat.
sqliteConfirmBody: This backs up first, then updates only thread-list display metadata in state_5.sqlite.
sqliteNoTranscript: It does not change session JSONL transcripts.
sqliteRestore: It writes a restore script and manifest into the backup folder.
sqliteAutoOff: Automatic execution is off by default.
newThreadPersonaPrompt: Start a new Telegram Codex session. Reply only with a short ready confirmation.
timeZoneDescription: Choose the IANA time zone used for reminders and timestamps.
timeZoneRegionDescription: Choose a city. Offsets are shown for the current date and daylight saving rules are handled by the IANA time zone.
timeZoneUtcDescription: Choose a fixed UTC offset. Use a city time zone instead when daylight saving time matters.
runtimeDescription: Change safe environment-style settings without editing .env.
queuePausedDetail: The current turn keeps running, but queued turns will not auto-run.
telegramDeliveryReplayDisabled: Automatic replay: disabled to avoid duplicates
queueModeSafeDescription: Queue new messages while a turn is running and process them in order.
queueModeInterruptDescription: Interrupt the current turn and run the new message next.
queueModeSideDescription: Keep the current turn running and answer the new message in a side thread.
queueClearConfirmBody: The current turn stays active; only queued turns are removed.
queueButtonsHelp: Use the buttons to control queue execution, mode, and item order.
forgetConfirmTitle: Forget this chat's thread binding and chat-specific settings?
forgetConfirmBody: This is only available when no turn is running.
forgetDone: Forgot the Codex thread and chat-specific options.
modelSelectionDescription: Choose a model; thinking buttons will be shown next.
thinkingSettingsDescription: Choose the thinking level to use.
fastSelectionDescription: Choose whether to use the Fast service tier.
selectionExpired: This selection has expired or was already completed.
selectionFinalizing: This selection is being saved and can no longer be cancelled.
selectionBlockedByActiveTurn: Finish or stop the active Codex turn before changing this setting.
selectionUpdateFailed: The message could not be updated. Please run the command again.
interruptRequestedDetail: The current turn will stop and the new message will run as the next turn.
sideTurnStartedDetail: The current turn continues, and a separate thread will answer.
codexTurnInterruptedDetail: The new message will run as the next turn.
recoveryStartedDetail: Checking the previous Codex task state and continuing in the same thread.
recoveryStartFailedDetail: An error occurred before the recovery turn could start. Check the recovery state.
recoveryIdleTitle: Restart recovery is waiting for Codex stream activity.
recoveryIdleDetail: No new Codex stream progress event has arrived for a while. The bot will keep waiting, then stop recovery safely if the hard limit is reached.
recoveryStreamIdleTimeoutDetail: The Codex stream stayed idle past the hard limit, so the recovery turn was stopped. Some work may already have progressed; check the state before continuing.
codexBadRequestRecoveryDetail: The Codex API rejected this turn. If this followed image inspection, check what already completed, then use /new and continue from the current file state. Inspect one resized image at a time instead of batching high-detail images.
handoffNoThreadError: No Codex thread is available for handoff. Connect a thread first with /resume or /new.
menuHelp: Open status, queue, settings, and tools in one panel.
settingsHelp: Change model, thinking, sandbox, approval, web, network, stream, language, time zone, and locale settings with buttons.
toolsHelp: Run skills, health, doctor, logs, backup, export, cleanup, and forget with buttons.
queueHelp: Control pause/resume, mode, cancel, up, and next with buttons.
accounts.title: 👥 Codex accounts
accounts.private: 🔐 Account management is available to account administrators in private chat only.
accounts.instruction: Select an account for future tasks. Running tasks keep their current account.
accounts.busy: A login is already pending. Use /reauth cancel to cancel it.
accounts.code: Open the official sign-in page and enter this one-time code. Complete sign-in in your browser.
accounts.done: ✅ Account added. Select it below to use it.
accounts.deleteConfirm: Remove this saved login and its account-local session files?
accounts.next: ✅ Account selected for the next task.
accounts.usageBrowseHint: Account buttons change the usage view only. Your task account stays the same. ✅ marks the account being viewed.
accounts.usageAccountMissing: This account is no longer saved. Choose another account below.
accounts.usageUnavailable: No quota information was returned for this account.
accounts.usageSignIn: Usage limits require a ChatGPT sign-in. Open Accounts to check or add an account.
accounts.usagePending: Finish this account's sign-in, then refresh its usage.
accounts.usageFailed: Could not load usage. Try Refresh, or check the sign-in status in Accounts.
accounts.usageResetCreditsUnavailable: Reset credit information was not provided.
accounts.usageResetDetailsUnavailable: Individual credit details were not provided.
accounts.resetChoose: Choose a credit below. You will confirm before using it; your task account stays the same.
accounts.resetAutomaticHint: The service selects one available Reset credit.
accounts.resetConfirmHint: Use one Reset credit for this account now? A successful reset consumes the credit and resets eligible Codex limits. This cannot be undone.
accounts.resetDone: ✅ Reset credit used. Updated limits are shown below.
accounts.resetAlreadyDone: ✅ This reset was already completed. No additional credit was used.
accounts.resetNotNeeded: ℹ️ There is no eligible limit to reset. No Reset credit was used.
accounts.resetNoCredit: ℹ️ No available Reset credit was found. Refresh the list.
accounts.resetLoadFailed: Could not load Reset credits. Refresh or check the account's sign-in status.
accounts.resetUncertain: The previous use request has not been confirmed. Recheck the same request below; it will not use an additional credit if already completed. Closing this menu does not cancel a submitted request.
accounts.resetBusy: This account's Reset credit request is in progress. Please wait, then refresh.
accounts.resetPendingNotice: Menu closed. The submitted Reset request is still unconfirmed; open Use Reset credit to recheck it.
accounts.resetButtons: Use the Reset credit buttons above, or close the menu to return to chat.
accounts.nameAdd: Send the name for your new account in your next message (1–48 characters). ChatGPT sign-in will follow. Cancel below to return to the menu.
accounts.nameRename: Send a new name for this account in your next message (1–48 characters). Cancel below to keep its name.
accounts.nameInvalid: Please send a name as text, using 1–48 characters. You can try again or use the Cancel button above.
accounts.uiExpired: This account menu step has expired or already finished. Open Accounts to start again.
accounts.deleteButtons: Use the confirmation or Cancel button above to finish this step.
accounts.defaultProtected: The host's default account cannot be removed from this menu. You can rename it.
workspace.expired: This menu expired. Open it again.
workspace.busy: Finish the current and queued tasks first.
workspace.useButtons: Use the buttons or close the menu to chat.
workspace.name: Name
workspace.pathPrompt: Enter an existing absolute folder path.
workspace.removeHint: Remove this saved entry? Files and session logs are kept.
workspace.projectOpened: Project selected. The next message starts a fresh session.
workspace.resumed: Session selected. Send your next message.
workspace.watchHint: Read-only log view · refreshes every 10 seconds · 15 minutes
workspace.sessionAllHint: All folders in this account, including CLI and automated tasks.
workspace.promptHint: Enter the request to run on schedule (up to 8000 characters).
workspace.chooseProject: Choose the project for this task.
workspace.scheduleHint: once: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM · daily: HH:MM · weekly: 1–7 HH:MM (Mon–Sun) · monthly: 1–31 HH:MM · interval: minutes (minimum 5)
workspace.confirmTask: Confirm the task, account, folder and timezone before saving.
workspace.pinUnavailable: Pin permission unavailable; showing an ordinary status message.
workspace.mcpHint: Settings apply to the selected account. Changes take effect on the next turn.
workspace.admin: Use this feature in a private chat as an account administrator.
workspace.capped: List capped; use search or enter a path.
forum.setupHint: Run /forum_setup inside a supergroup with Topics enabled. Give the bot the Manage Topics administrator right. Use /projects to save folders first.
forum.privateSetupHint: Enable Topics for this bot in @BotFather, then run /forum_setup here or press Set up private topics again. No group is needed. Save folders with /projects first.
forum.privateHint: Each project topic has its own folder, account and session. Your existing conversation keeps its settings. Choose Send work to dispatch a request to a project.
forum.privateOpenHint: Choose this topic by name in Telegram's topic list to send it messages.
forum.privateConfirmPause: Pause new bot work in this idle topic? Messages and history are kept; you can resume it later.
forum.privatePaused: ⏸ Bot work is paused in this topic.
forum.managerHint: General is the manager. Send a request here, then choose a project topic. Results appear in the project and completion is reported here. AI Chat uses the workspace.
forum.pathHint: Enter an existing absolute folder path or an exact saved project name.
forum.name: Topic name
forum.unbound: Project not bound yet. Choose a saved project or enter its folder path.
forum.choose: Choose the project topic to run this request.
forum.sent: 📨 Request queued in the project topic
forum.reportUnknown: Notification delivery needs checking; execution will not be repeated.
forum.unbindHint: Disconnect this topic? The topic, files and session logs are kept.
forum.confirmClose: Close this idle topic? You can reopen it later.
forum.forumOnly: Run /forum_setup in this private chat or forum group, then open /topics.
forum.busy: This topic has unfinished work. Wait or stop it in that topic first.
forum.attachments: Send attachments inside the project topic. The manager accepts text requests.
